questions.content:
题二.

(1) 进入圆盘之前和离开圆盘之后，小球在桌面上作纯滚动。在桌面上无滑动时，小球对桌面上任一点P的水平角动量:

![](data/images/2024-3c90124c/2024-兰阶-暑假-理论-第八套-5.jpg)

$$\vec{L} = J\vec{\omega} + \vec{r} \times m\vec{v}_{c} = J\vec{\omega} - (\vec{b} + \vec{r}_{\parallel}) \times m\vec{v}_{c} = J\vec{\omega} - \vec{b} \times m\vec{v}_{c} - \vec{r}_{\parallel} \times m\vec{v}_{c}.$$

$$\vec{L}_{水平} = J\vec{\omega} - \vec{b} \times m\vec{v}_{c}$$

无滑动时，$\vec{v}_{B} = \vec{v}_{C} + \vec{\omega} \times \vec{b} = 0 \Rightarrow \vec{v}_{C} = -\vec{\omega} \times \vec{b}$

$$\vec{L}_{水平} = J\vec{\omega} + m\vec{b} \times (\vec{\omega} \times \vec{b}) = (J + mb^2)\vec{\omega}$$

整个运动过程摩擦力对P点的力矩沿竖直方向。小球对P点的水平角动量守恒。

![](data/images/2024-3c90124c/2024-兰阶-暑假-理论-第八套-6.jpg)

$$\vec{L}_{水平} = 常量 \Rightarrow \vec{\omega} = 常量 \Rightarrow \vec{v}_{c} = -\vec{\omega} \times \vec{b} = 常量$$

小球初始质心速度与离开圆盘后的质心速度相等（含大小和方向）。

$$(\vec{b} \times \frac{\mathrm{d}\vec{v}_{c}}{\mathrm{d}t}) \times \vec{b} = b^{2} \frac{\mathrm{d}\vec{v}_{c}}{\mathrm{d}t}$$

$$(7) \rightarrow (6): \frac{\mathrm{d}\vec{v}_{c}}{\mathrm{d}t} = \vec{\Omega} \times \vec{v}_{c} - \frac{mb^{2}}{J} \frac{\mathrm{d}\vec{v}_{c}}{\mathrm{d}t}$$

$$m\frac{\mathrm{d}\vec{v}_{c}}{\mathrm{d}t} = -\frac{m}{1+mb^{2}/J}\vec{v}_{c} \times \Omega \quad (J=\frac{2}{5}mb^{2})$$

![](data/images/2024-3c90124c/2024-兰阶-暑假-理论-第八套-7.jpg)

以桌面为参照系

$$-\frac{2}{7}m\vec{v}_{c} \times \Omega$$

$$\vec{q} = -\frac{2}{7}m, \vec{B} = \vec{\Omega} \Rightarrow m\frac{\mathrm{d}\vec{v}_{c}}{\mathrm{d}t} = q\vec{v}_{c} \times \vec{B}$$

$v \perp \Omega \Rightarrow v \perp B$ 小球作匀速圆周运动

$$R' = \frac{mv_{c}}{|q|B} = \frac{7}{2}\frac{v_{c}}{\Omega}$$

![](data/images/2024-3c90124c/2024-兰阶-暑假-理论-第八套-8.jpg)

(2)

小球与圆盘间的摩擦系数足够大，小球进入圆盘区域后很快达到无滑动。

$$\left\{ \begin{aligned} \vec{f} &= m\frac{\mathrm{d}\vec{v}_{c}}{\mathrm{d}t} \quad (1) \\ \vec{\tau}_{c} &= \vec{b} \times \vec{f} = J\frac{\mathrm{d}\vec{\omega}}{\mathrm{d}t} \quad (2) \\ \vec{v}_{c} &= \vec{\Omega} \times \vec{r} - \vec{\omega} \times \vec{b} \quad (3) \end{aligned} \right.$$

![](data/images/2024-3c90124c/2024-兰阶-暑假-理论-第八套-9.jpg)

以桌面为参照系

(1) $m\vec{b} \times \frac{\mathrm{d}\vec{v}_{c}}{\mathrm{d}t} = J\frac{\mathrm{d}\vec{\omega}}{\mathrm{d}t} \Rightarrow \frac{\mathrm{d}\vec{\omega}}{\mathrm{d}t} = \frac{m}{J}\vec{b} \times \frac{\mathrm{d}\vec{v}_{c}}{\mathrm{d}t}$ (4)

(3) $\Rightarrow \frac{\mathrm{d}\vec{v}_{C}}{\mathrm{d}t} = \vec{\Omega} \times \frac{\mathrm{d}\vec{r}}{\mathrm{d}t} - \frac{\mathrm{d}\vec{\omega}}{\mathrm{d}t} \times \vec{b} = \vec{\Omega} \times \vec{v}_{C} - \frac{\mathrm{d}\vec{\omega}}{\mathrm{d}t} \times \vec{b}$ (5)

(4) $\rightarrow$ (5): $\frac{\mathrm{d}\vec{v}_{c}}{\mathrm{d}t} = \vec{\Omega} \times \vec{v}_{c} - \frac{m}{J}(\vec{b} \times \frac{\mathrm{d}\vec{v}_{c}}{\mathrm{d}t}) \times \vec{b}$ (6)

摩擦力很大 $\Rightarrow$ 小球进入圆盘区域后很快达到无滑动，此过程速度快速改变，位移可忽略。此过程中圆盘上与小球接触点的速度近似等于圆盘边缘的速度，可视为常量。

$$\left\{ \begin{aligned} \vec{f} &= m\frac{\mathrm{d}\vec{v}_{c}}{\mathrm{d}t} \\ \vec{\tau}_{c} &= \vec{b} \times \vec{f} = J\frac{\mathrm{d}\vec{\omega}}{\mathrm{d}t} \\ \vec{u} &= \vec{v}_{c} + \vec{\omega} \times \vec{b} - \vec{b} \end{aligned} \right. ,$$

![](data/images/2024-3c90124c/2024-兰阶-暑假-理论-第八套-10.jpg)

以桌面为参照系

![](data/images/2024-3c90124c/2024-兰阶-暑假-理论-第八套-11.jpg)

$$\frac{\mathrm{d}\vec{u}}{\mathrm{d}t} = \frac{\mathrm{d}\vec{v}_{r}}{\mathrm{d}t} + \frac{\mathrm{d}\vec{\omega}}{\mathrm{d}t} \times \vec{b} = \frac{1}{m}\vec{f} + \frac{1}{J}(\vec{b} \times \vec{f}) \times \vec{b} = \frac{1}{m}\vec{f} + \frac{b^{2}}{J}\vec{f} = -\frac{7}{2}\mu g\vec{e}_{m}$$

球面上与圆盘接触的点相对圆盘的速度方向保持不变！$\vec{e}_{\mu} = \vec{e}_{\mu 0}$ 为恒量 $\vec{f} = -\mu mg\vec{e}_{u_{0}}$

![](data/images/2024-3c90124c/2024-兰阶-暑假-理论-第八套-12.jpg)

(2)

带电球壳在变化的匀强磁场 $\beta$ 中受到的感生电场力矩:

$$\oint_{L} \vec{E} \cdot d\vec{l} = -\frac{d\Phi}{dt}$$

$$2\pi xE_{1} = -\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}(\pi x^{2}B) = -\pi x^{2}\frac{\mathrm{d}B}{\mathrm{d}t} \Rightarrow E_{1} = -\frac{x}{2}\frac{\mathrm{d}B}{\mathrm{d}t}$$

$$\mathrm{d}q = \sigma \cdot 2\pi x \cdot R\mathrm{d}\theta = \frac{Qx}{2R}\mathrm{d}\theta$$

![](data/images/2024-3c90124c/2024-兰阶-暑假-理论-第八套-13.jpg)

$$\mathrm{d}\tau_{i} = \mathrm{d}qE_{i} \cdot x = -\frac{Q}{4R}\frac{\mathrm{d}B}{\mathrm{d}t}x^{3}\mathrm{d}\theta = -\frac{QR^{2}}{4}\frac{\mathrm{d}B}{\mathrm{d}t}\sin^{3}\theta\mathrm{d}\theta$$

$$\tau_{i} = -\frac{QR^{2}}{4}\frac{\mathrm{d}B}{\mathrm{d}t}\int_{0}^{\pi}\sin^{3}\theta\mathrm{d}\theta = -\frac{1}{3}QR^{2}\frac{\mathrm{d}B}{\mathrm{d}t}$$

$$B = B_{\mu_{1}} = \frac{\mu_{0}Q}{6\pi R} \Rightarrow \tau_{i} = -\frac{\mu_{0}Q^{2}R}{18\pi}\beta$$

(3) 考察内球壳的运动:

$$\tau_{i}' = -\frac{1}{3}Q'R'^{2}\frac{\mathrm{d}B}{\mathrm{d}t} = -\frac{\mu_{0}Q'R'^{2}}{18\pi}\left(\frac{Q\beta}{R} + \frac{Q'\beta'}{R'}\right)$$

$$\tau_{i}' = J'\beta' \Rightarrow -\frac{\mu_{0}Q'R'^{2}}{18\pi}\left(\frac{Q\beta}{R} + \frac{Q'\beta'}{R'}\right) = \frac{2}{3}m'R'^{2}\beta'$$

![](data/images/2024-3c90124c/2024-兰阶-暑假-理论-第八套-14.jpg)

$$\beta' = -\frac{\mu_{0}QQ'R'}{12\pi m'RR' + \mu_{0}Q'^{2}R}\beta$$

$$\omega' = -\frac{\mu_{0}QQ'R'}{12\pi m'RR' + \mu_{0}Q'^{2}R}\omega$$

![](data/images/2024-3c90124c/2024-兰阶-暑假-理论-第八套-15.jpg)

$$\tau + \tau_{i} = J\beta$$

$$\tau - \frac{\mu_{0}Q^{2}R}{18\pi}\beta = \frac{2}{3}mR^{2}\beta$$

$$\tau = \left(\frac{2}{3}mR^{2} + \frac{\mu_{0}Q^{2}R}{18\pi}\right)\beta = \left(\frac{2}{3}mR^{2} + \frac{\mu_{0}Q^{2}R}{18\pi}\right)\frac{d\omega}{dt} = \left(\frac{2}{3}mR^{2} + \frac{\mu_{0}Q^{2}R}{18\pi}\right)\omega\frac{d\omega}{d\theta}$$

$$I = \int_{0}^{t}\tau\mathrm{d}t = \int_{0}^{\infty}\left(\frac{\mu_{0}Q^{2}R}{18\pi} + \frac{2}{3}mR^{2}\right)\mathrm{d}\omega = \left(\frac{\mu_{0}Q^{2}R}{18\pi} + \frac{2}{3}mR^{2}\right)\omega$$

$$A = \int_{0}^{\theta}\tau\mathrm{d}\theta = \int_{0}^{\infty}\left(\frac{\mu_{0}Q^{2}R}{18\pi} + \frac{2}{3}mR^{2}\right)\mathrm{d}\theta = \left(\frac{\mu_{0}Q^{2}R}{36\pi} + \frac{1}{3}mR^{2}\right)\omega^{2}$$

(4) 考察外球壳的运动:

$$\oint \vec{E}_{i} \cdot \mathrm{d}\vec{l} = -\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}(\Phi + \Phi')$$

$\Phi$ 外球壳产生的磁通量 $\Phi'$ 内球壳产生的磁通量

$$\left|\vec{E}_{i} \cdot \mathrm{d}\vec{l} = 2\pi xE_{i}\right|$$

$$\Phi = \pi x^{2}B_{\text{内}}$$

![](data/images/2024-3c90124c/2024-兰阶-暑假-理论-第八套-16.jpg)

$$\int_{x}\vec{B}' \cdot \mathrm{d}\vec{S} = 0 \Rightarrow \Phi' = -\Phi'_{\text{因外}}$$

内球与 $\mu$ 在圆外的磁通相同 $\Rightarrow$ 内球与 $\mu$ 在圆内的磁通相同

$$\begin{aligned}\mathrm{d}\Phi' &= \vec{B}' \cdot \mathrm{d}\vec{S} = \vec{B} \cdot \vec{e}_{z}\mathrm{d}S = \frac{\mu_{0}}{4\pi}\left[\frac{3(\vec{\mu}' \cdot \vec{r}')(\vec{r}' \cdot \vec{e}_{z})}{r'^{5}} - \frac{\vec{\mu}' \cdot \vec{e}_{z}}{r'^{3}}\right]\mathrm{d}S \\ &= \frac{\mu_{0}\mu'}{4\pi r'^{3}}(3\cos^{2}\theta' - 1)\mathrm{d}S\end{aligned}$$

$$r' = \frac{R\cos\theta}{\cos\theta'}, \quad \mathrm{d}S = 2\pi x'\mathrm{d}x' = 2\pi R\cos\theta\tan\theta'\mathrm{d}(R\cos\theta\tan\theta') = 2\pi R^{2}\cos^{2}\theta\tan\theta'\sec^{2}\theta'\mathrm{d}\theta'$$

$$\mathrm{d}\Phi' = \frac{\mu_{0}\mu'}{2R}\frac{(3\cos^{2}\theta' - 1)}{\cos\theta}\sin\theta'\mathrm{d}\theta'$$

$$\Phi' = \frac{\mu_{0}\mu'}{2R\cos\theta}\int_{0}^{\theta}(3\cos^{2}\theta' - 1)\sin\theta'\mathrm{d}\theta' = \frac{\mu_{0}\mu'\sin^{2}\theta}{2R} = \frac{\mu_{0}\mu'x^{2}}{2R^{3}}$$

$$2\pi xE_{t} = -\pi x^{2}\frac{dB_{\text{内}}}{dt} - \frac{\mu_{0}x^{2}}{2R^{3}}\frac{d\mu'}{dt}$$

$$E_{i} = -\frac{x}{2}\frac{dB_{\text{内}}}{dt} - \frac{\mu_{0}x}{4\pi R^{3}}\frac{d\mu'}{dt}$$

$$B_{\text{内}} = \frac{\mu_{0}Q}{6\pi R}\omega, \quad \mu' = \frac{1}{3}Q'R'^{2}\omega'$$

$$E_{i} = -\frac{\mu_{0}(Q\beta R^{2} + Q'\beta'R'^{2})}{12\pi R^{3}}x$$

另解: $\Phi' = 2$

$\Phi'$ 等于位于球心的磁偶极子 $\mu$ 产生通过回路L的磁通量；将磁偶极子 $\mu'$ 等效于一小载流线圈。

$$M = \frac{\Phi_{f}}{I} = \frac{1}{I} \cdot \frac{\mu_{0}}{2}\frac{x^{2}I}{(x^{2} + y^{2})^{3/2}} \cdot S' = \frac{\mu_{0}S'x^{2}}{2R^{3}}$$

$$\Phi' = MI' = \frac{\mu_{0}I'S'x^{2}}{2R^{3}} = \frac{\mu_{0}\mu'x^{2}}{2R^{3}}$$

![](data/images/2024-3c90124c/2024-兰阶-暑假-理论-第八套-17.jpg)

$$\mathrm{d}q = \sigma \cdot 2\pi x \cdot R\mathrm{d}\theta = \frac{Qx}{2R}\mathrm{d}\theta$$

$$\mathrm{d}\tau_{i} = \mathrm{d}qE_{i} \cdot x = -\frac{\mu_{0}Q(Q\beta R^{2} + Q'\beta'R'^{2})}{24\pi R^{4}}x^{3}\mathrm{d}\theta$$

$$-\frac{\mu_{0}Q(Q\beta R^{2} + Q'\beta'R'^{2})}{24\pi R}\sin^{3}\theta\mathrm{d}\theta$$

$$\tau_{i} = -\frac{\mu_{0}Q(Q\beta R^{2} + Q'\beta'R'^{2})}{24\pi R}\int_{0}^{\pi}\sin^{3}\theta\mathrm{d}\theta = -\frac{\mu_{0}Q(Q\beta R^{2} + Q'\beta'R'^{2})}{18\pi R}$$

$$\tau_{i} + \tau = J\beta \Rightarrow$$

$$\tau = J\beta - \tau_{i} = \frac{2}{3}mR^{2}\beta + \frac{\mu_{0}Q(Q\beta R^{2} + Q'\beta'R'^{2})}{18\pi R}$$

$$\left(\frac{2}{3}mR^{2} + \frac{\mu_{0}Q^{2}R}{18\pi}\right)\beta + \frac{\mu_{0}QQ'R'^{2}}{18\pi R}\beta'$$

$$I = \int_{0}^{t}\tau\mathrm{d}t = \left(\frac{2}{3}mR^{2} + \frac{\mu_{0}Q^{2}R}{18\pi}\right)\int_{0}^{t}\beta\mathrm{d}t + \frac{\mu_{0}QQ'R'^{2}}{18\pi R}\int_{0}^{t}\beta'\mathrm{d}t$$

$$\left(\frac{2}{3}mR^{2} + \frac{\mu_{0}Q^{2}R}{18\pi}\right)\omega + \frac{\mu_{0}QQ'R'^{2}}{18\pi R}\omega'$$

![](data/images/2024-3c90124c/2024-兰阶-暑假-理论-第八套-18.jpg)

$$\frac{\omega R}{18\pi}\left[12\pi mR + \mu_{0}Q^{2} - \frac{(\mu_{0}QQ')^{2}}{12\pi m'R' + \mu_{0}Q'^{2}}\frac{R'^{3}}{R^{3}}\right]$$

题五.

(1.1)

$$
\left\{ \begin{aligned} I ^ { 2 } R ( x ) = q ( x ) - q ( 0 ) = - \kappa \frac { \mathrm { d } T } { \mathrm { d } x } S - q ( 0 ) , \\ R ( x ) = \rho \frac { x } { S } \end{aligned} \right.
$$

![](data/images/2024-3c90124c/2024-兰阶-暑假-理论-第八套-19.jpg)

$$
\rho I^{2} \frac{\ddot{x}}{S} = - q(0) - \kappa \frac{\mathrm{d}T}{\mathrm{d}x} S \Rightarrow \mathrm{d}T = - \frac{1}{\kappa S} \left[ q(0) + \rho I^{2} \frac{x}{S} \right] \mathrm{d}x.
$$

$$
\int_{T_{1}}^{T(x)} \mathrm{d}T = - \frac{1}{\kappa S} \int_{0}^{x} \left[ q(0) + \rho I^{2} \frac{x}{S} \right] \mathrm{d}x \Rightarrow T(x) = T_{1} - \frac{q(0)}{\kappa S} x - \frac{\rho I^{2}}{2 \kappa S^{2}} x^{2}
$$

$$
T(L) = T_2 \Rightarrow q(0) = \frac{\kappa S}{L}(T_1 - T_2) - \frac{\rho L I^2}{2 S}
$$

$$
T ( x ) = T _ { 1 } - \left( \frac { T _ { 1 } - T _ { 2 } } { L } - \frac { \rho _ { 0 } L I ^ { 2 } } { 2 \kappa S ^ { 2 } } \right) x - \frac { \rho _ { 0 } I ^ { 2 } } { 2 \kappa S ^ { 2 } } x ^ { 2 }
$$

(2)

$$
T_{1} > T_{2}
$$

$$
q_{1} = \pi_{1} I, q_{2} = \pi_{2} I
$$

questions.content:
二.（48分）某科技馆有这样一套装置：在水平桌面的中心位置挖掉一个圆盘，然后将圆盘通过一根过圆盘中心的竖直转轴重新安装到其原来的位置上，并通过外界驱动，使圆盘绕竖直轴以恒定角速度转动，如图所示。利用该装置可观察到以下有趣的实验现象：一个硬橡皮小球（质量均匀分布，半径远小于圆盘半径，与桌面和圆盘间的摩擦系数均非常大（远大于1）），起初在桌面上沿直线作纯滚动，当进入圆盘区域后，小球偏离其直线轨道而沿曲线运动，但当小球离开圆盘后，又迅速恢复到原来的轨迹，沿与入射同方向的直线作纯滚动，且最终速度与初始速度大小相等。

（1）请分析产生上述现象的原理。[12分]

（2）证明在桌面参照系中看，小球在圆盘上做匀速圆周运动（除了短暂滑动过程外）。[18分]

（3）已知小球的初速度为 $v_0$，圆盘半径为 $R$，圆盘转动的角速度为 $\Omega = v_0/R$，小球进入圆盘的入射速度方向与入射点到圆盘圆心连线的夹角为 $30^\circ$。求相对于桌面参照系，小球在圆盘上做圆周运动的速度大小和轨道半径。不考虑小球越过圆盘边界时的速度变化。[18分]
